nodes.label: cover-dusk.jpg (mockup cover fixture)
nodes.description: Square placeholder cover image: grainy abstract dusk gradient, deep navy at top-left, a violet-blue glow at lower-left, blending to warm peach/salmon at bottom-right. No subject or text; a stand-in photo for entry covers served from MOCKUP_PHOTOS_DIR in e2e/mockups.

nodes.label: Dusk Gradient Palette (navy, violet, peach)
nodes.rationale: A neutral, contentless gradient with film-grain noise makes a realistic-looking cover stand-in without copyrighted artwork, and its full-bleed tonal range exercises cover cropping and text-over-image contrast.
